scripts.build: npm run build -w @notepad/shared && npm run build -w auth-service -w notes-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @notepad/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:auth: npm run build -w @notepad/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,auth -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @notepad/shared" "npm run dev -w auth-service"
scripts.dev:notes: npm run build -w @notepad/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,notes -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @notepad/shared" "npm run dev -w notes-service"
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @notepad/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,auth,notes -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @notepad/shared" "npm run dev -w auth-service" "npm run dev -w notes-service"
